meaning:
ἑκουσίως
adv., [in LXX: Psa.54:6 (נְדָבָה) 2Ma.14:3, al. ;]
voluntarily, willingly: Heb.10:26, 1Pe.5:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
